conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.subtitle: Keep a consistent quality scale across the entire collection.
conditions.emptyBody: Create your first condition to start tracking the quality of your assets.

conditions.label: Condition Label
conditions.labelHint: The display name shown when selecting a condition.
conditions.sortOrderHint: Controls the display order. Lower numbers appear first.
conditions.newSubtitle: Define a new quality level to describe the state of your assets.
conditions.quickStartHint: Choose a common quality level or create your own.
conditions.detailsHint: Set the label, stable code, and position in the scale.
conditions.codeHint: A unique uppercase identifier. Auto-generated from label.
conditions.tipBody: Common condition scales range from "New" to "For Parts/Repair". You can customize these to match your needs, such as "Sealed" for collectibles or "Restored" for antiques.
conditions.notFoundBody: The condition you're looking for doesn't exist or has been deleted.
conditions.editSubtitle: Update how this quality level appears throughout the collection.
conditions.detailsHintEdit: The code stays fixed so existing integrations remain stable.
conditions.codeHintEdit: The code cannot be changed after creation.
conditions.noteBody: Changing the label or sort order will update how this condition appears across all assets using it.

google.instruction: Create an API key in a Google Cloud project with the Books API enabled.
google.note: Google Books also works without a key, with a lower shared quota.

tmdb.instruction: Create a TMDB account and request an API key. Use the API key for v3 requests.
tmdb.note: One key enables both Movies and TV Series.

bgg.instruction: Register an application. Once approved, create an application token in the applications dashboard.

igdb.instruction: Register a Twitch application and copy its Client ID and Client Secret.
igdb.note: Keep the Client Secret private. Attic exchanges it for a short-lived access token held only in memory.

rebrickable.instruction: Create a free Rebrickable account and generate an API key.
rebrickable.note: One key enables both LEGO Sets and LEGO Minifigures.
